macros.name: initialI
macros.doc: The macro \initialI sets the tall version of initial I in blue into the margin or gutter using a very large size.

macros.name: msabbr
macros.doc: Command \msabbr{} is a macro that enables the abbreviation ligatures defined by dlig.

macros.name: MsAltAEStyle
macros.doc: Changes the æ and œ ligatures to the form where the e is set above the letter instead of being fused into it.

macros.name: MsAltGStyle
macros.doc: Changes the shape of the upper case G to a different form.

macros.name: msaltpunctuation
macros.doc: Switches to use alternate punctuation marks.

macros.name: MsAltZStyle
macros.doc: Changes the shape of the lower case z to a slightly different form.

macros.name: mschapterinitial
macros.doc: Sets a red two-line chapter initial.

macros.name: mschapterinitialblue
macros.doc: Sets a blue two-line chapter initial.

macros.name: mschapterinitialgreen
macros.doc: Sets a green two-line chapter initial.

macros.name: mschapterinitialwithcolor
macros.doc: Sets a two-line chapter initial with a specified color.

macros.name: msinit
macros.doc: Inserts a Lombardic initial using the current size and color.

macros.name: msinita
macros.doc: Inserts an alternate form of a Lombardic initial using the current size and color.

macros.name: msmanualspacing
macros.doc: Turns on the manually-adjusted spacing for text.

macros.name: msnoliga
macros.doc: Turns off the standard ligature substitution for its argument.

macros.name: MsNormalStyle
macros.doc: Revert back to the standard style, cancels the effect of other style definition macros.

macros.name: mspara
macros.doc: Inserts a red paragraph symbol.

macros.name: msparinitial
macros.doc: Sets a one line high red Lombardic initial.

macros.name: msparinitialblue
macros.doc: Sets a one line high blueLombardic initial.

macros.name: msparinitialgreen
macros.doc: Sets a one line high green Lombardic initial.

macros.name: mspartialline
macros.doc: Sets a partial line of text with a rubric after it.

macros.name: mspartialrubric
macros.doc: Sets text at the right end of the current line in red.

macros.name: mspartialrubricwithcolor
macros.doc: Sets a partial rubric in given color.

macros.name: msrubric
macros.doc: Inserts text in red.

macros.name: msrubricblue
macros.doc: Inserts text in blue.

macros.name: msrubricgreen
macros.doc: Inserts text in green.

macros.name: mssetblocklines
macros.doc: This sets how many lines of text there are on each page of the mstextura environment.

macros.name: mssetblockwidth
macros.doc: This sets the width of the textura block to a given dimension.

macros.name: mssetfontsize
macros.doc: This sets the font size.

macros.name: mssetsizes
macros.doc: This sets the font size, text block width, and the number of lines on a page in one call.

macros.name: msstartchapter
macros.doc: This sets a two-line initial in red, and then the contents of the first line and the second line to its right indented by the proper abount.

macros.name: msstartchapterblue
macros.doc: This sets a two-line initial in blue, and then the contents of the first line and the second line to its right indented by the proper abount.

macros.name: msstartchaptergreen
macros.doc: This sets a two-line initial in green, and then the contents of the first line and the second line to its right indented by the proper abount.

macros.name: msstartchapterwithrubric
macros.doc: This sets a two-line initial in red, and the contents of the first line and at its end the rubric in red.

macros.name: msstartchapterwithrubricandcolors
macros.doc: This sets a chapter start with a partial line rubric in two colors: color1 is the color of the initial and the rubric is in color2.

macros.name: msstartchapterwithrubricgreen
macros.doc: This sets a two-line initial in green, and the contents of the first line and at its end the rubric in red.

macros.name: mstdl
macros.doc: Turns on the liturgical variants of the symbols.

macros.name: rotundar
macros.doc: Inserts a forced r-rotunda to a place where ordinary contextual substitution rules would place a straight r.

macros.name: shorts
macros.doc: Inserts a forced short s in a place where the contextual substitution rules would place a long s.
